# kion_app_api_key (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion AppApiKey by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_app_api_key" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the AppApiKey to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
